'''2001 Meriden Tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held in Meriden, Connecticut in 2001.<ref name="dt-14524">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14524 BHBM Killa Style Improved], DeckTech (Joe "Mirax" Kollisch, 12 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14524/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14524/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 10 March 2001<ref name="tr-d1876" />
* '''Site:''' Meriden, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]<ref name="tr-d1876" />
* '''Players:''' 22<ref name="tr-d1876" />

The event is known only from a DeckTech post of 12 March 2001, which dates it to the weekend before. It was played under [[Premiere - Reflections II]].
